themes.summary: Many users say AI mind-mapping from books, audio, YouTube and URLs is fast, simple and useful.

hits.quote: It created a clear mind map of the business system and did a surprisingly good job organizing everything.
I found nodeland powerful and useful and then added it into my Claude connections.
Very simple mind mapping tool. AI features help break down lots of different content visually.
It's very fast to put in stuff, add new nodes, change sizes of nodes
I didn't knew there exists a tool that does YouTube summaries.
Found this little gem, we have canva but canva is harder to use because it isn't whiteboard-specific, and doesn't have the features this has.

themes.summary: Several users report crashes, lost work, stuck uploads, broken undo and navigation bugs.

hits.quote: I was working on project and lost all my text it did not save.
Files over 0.4mb start getting stuck at 100%
Too many bugs and feature improvements needed.
As I experienced dithering and slippery nodes jumping all the time with nodeland.io
There is a "redo/undo" button, but it does not seem to restore something even immediately after accidentally deleting a node.
Unable to retrieve my created map. Bye.

themes.summary: Several buyers say Gabriel and the team reply quickly and fix setup and activation issues.

hits.quote: Every time I emailed them with a question, they replied almost instantly.
I wrote them and Gabriel's response was thoughtful and thorough - and he did not give excuses but offered explanations.
Gabriel from the NodeLand team responded quickly and solved my activation issue with patience and professionalism.
Initially there were a couple of issues but they did get resolved once I mailed them.
Support relies in a timely manner.

themes.summary: Buyers repeatedly call the lifetime deal outstanding value for money.

hits.quote: And all for US $19!, Lifetime.
absolute value for money, This product is awesome, super minimal, and gets right to the point.
for the price, it's hard to go wrong on this deal, especially if you're a graphic-oriented person like me.
Up the price, this is worth more.
NodeLand is an excellent app that offers great value at a very affordable price

themes.summary: Several reviewers say the interface is basic, unintuitive and missing core mind-map controls and exports.

hits.quote: The interface is anything but modern and not intuitive at all.
there being no real instructions or easy to access Help for some of the basic functions
Export to PDF is a must
la rappresentazione grafica è davvero basilare e non permette molta personalizzazione.
However, I feel it is too early for this app to be in AppSumo given that there are a few alternative apps that have more features and better UIX.

themes.summary: Critics say AI summaries are superficial, generic, inconsistent and slow on larger documents.

hits.quote: NoteLand offers a quick, but super simple and superficial summary of websites and smaller documents.
AI summary is limited and uses it's own summary instead of data provided
The other 50% it just gives me the basic key topics with no connections.
